About Me

The creator behind Yoruoto Music

Hi, I'm Yuzi, a solo indie developer. I built Yoruoto Music because I wanted a clean, fast and beautiful place to listen to the songs I love, on any device.

Yoruoto Music is still in development. I'm improving it over time and adding new features. Thank you for being part of the journey.
